#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /workspace/Antigravity_additions
export UV_CACHE_DIR=/workspace/.cache/uv
export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/workspace/.venvs/antigravity
uv sync --frozen --extra dev --extra mcp --python 3.12
config.start_skill:
Use the existing isolated checkout at /workspace/Antigravity_additions; do not create a Git worktree unless explicitly requested. Preserve tracked files during environment setup; make source changes only when the user requests coding work.

Activate the prepared development environment:
```bash
cd /workspace/Antigravity_additions
export PATH=/workspace/.venvs/antigravity/bin:$PATH
export UV_CACHE_DIR=/workspace/.cache/uv
export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/workspace/.venvs/antigravity
cochem --version
cochem-mcp --version
cochem-pipeline --version
cochem-supervisor --version
python -m pytest pipeline_tests mcp_tests supervisor_tests -q
```
The repository's default pytest testpaths now select pipeline_tests, mcp_tests and supervisor_tests; the explicit command above selects the same active suites. These suites exercise native CLI adapter contracts, physical subprocesses, real SQLite/concurrency, real loopback HTTP and OS resource measurements. Clearly labelled fixture CLI output does not establish live model inference. Windows SYSTEM/ACL/Job Object integration tests deliberately skip on Linux. No persistent service is needed for these development checks.

The production pipeline retained from 4.2.2 requires Windows Python 3.12+, a machine-protected installation, SYSTEM Scheduled Task, separate worker identities and subscription logins. Read docs/PIPELINE_4.2.2.md and docs/REQUIREMENTS_4.2.2.md. Do not try to bypass the Linux fail-closed guard or claim Windows acceptance here. The Agy headless/auth/result contract must be verified on the actual Windows host; the example config contains rejected placeholders. scripts/inspect_agy_windows.ps1 captures version/help without inference. scripts/verify_pipeline_acceptance.py requires explicit --run-live and real configured providers, and uses the running authenticated service.

The existing scientific library remains available. Optional GPU/ML, ORCA/CREST/xTB/Open Babel, unrelated legacy v4 suites and their known Windows-dependent failures are outside the pipeline readiness claim. Never copy credentials into this setup, source control or logs. Use existing native CLI subscription login and the platform Git proxy; do not request API keys as a substitute.

The supervisor introduced in 4.2.3 is a separate protected Windows installation/venv with its own incident ledger. Read docs/SUPERVISOR_4.2.3.md before configuring its daemon, repair identity, source allowlist, external immutable acceptance tests, release pointer or native repair CLI. Default policy: one restart before model escalation for heartbeat/native-status incidents; two repair reservations per incident, four per UTC day, and a 30-minute cooldown. Operator request-update uses this same bounded gate. auto_deploy=false leaves a validated candidate BLOCKED; no manual promotion command exists. Repair cannot modify the protected supervisor, tests, policy or dependencies; database/schema migration is outside its code-release mechanism. Live candidate smoke checks add provider quota beyond the repair call. Linux contract tests do not prove Windows or live-model repair acceptance. The local proposed setup JSON has not been applied to a cloud draft: the earlier save returned stale_base. Do not retry that stale draft; a future setup chat can apply the recipe to a fresh draft.

For 4.2.4, read docs/ROUTING_4.2.4.md and docs/RELEASE_4.2.4.md. The corrected routing bands are 1-3 Flash/Haiku/Luna, 4-6 Sonnet/Sol/Gemini Pro, 7-9 Opus/Astra low/Gemini Pro, and 10 Fable/Astra ultra (only two routes). Controller-scored content selects the immutable route policy; model-supplied scores do not grant authority. Final synthesis remains Gemini 3.1 Pro. Route ceilings of zero mean no operator ceiling; availability waits use durable bounded backoff. Upgrade through a fresh protected Supervisor4.2.4 source/test snapshot, preserve native worker/repair credentials and task names, and migrate the previous supervisor ledger using the SYSTEM SQLite-backup helper. Do not reset repair budgets or reuse frozen 4.2.3 acceptance policy for 4.2.4 routing. Prior tasks must be stopped and disabled; activation follows full Windows Restart and real host acceptance.

For 4.2.5 read docs/EXECUTION_4.2.5.md and docs/REQUIREMENTS_4.2.5.md. Native Windows deployment uses fresh Pipeline4.2.5/Supervisor4.2.5 source and external tests; preserve worker identities, native subscription logins, task names and existing repair budgets. SYSTEM provision-execution checks real ImDisk/AWE RAM storage, Docker readiness and hardware sensors before registration. None of these Windows operations are proved by Linux tests. Current Docker tests use the existing local engine and an explicitly built exact image ID; without COCHEM_TEST_DOCKER_IMAGE the live container cases explicitly skip. To include real Docker tests, verify docker info, read the cloud runtime skill for proxy/CA/build rules, build with scripts/build_pipeline_sandbox.py, and use its actual emitted image field as COCHEM_TEST_DOCKER_IMAGE for python -m pytest pipeline_tests/test_containers.py -q. Do not substitute a mutable tag or claim skipped Docker cases passed. Missing engines/images or native hardware sensors are explicit prerequisites. Container timing distinguishes a measured warm single-use fixture (0.4446 seconds, within the historical 1.5-second target) from cold creation (4.85 seconds, above target). Preserve warm_pool_used and the reported SLA result; neither measurement proves Windows or representative-load latency. The Docker GitHub Actions job builds the reviewed image and runs actual container checks; its presence is not evidence that remote CI has passed.

For 4.2.6 read docs/EXECUTION_4.2.6.md, docs/REQUIREMENTS_4.2.6.md and docs/PLANNING_PREREQUISITES.md. Earlier 4.2.5 compliance claims are superseded: candidate-produced JUnit can be forged, so promotion additionally requires the independent outer physical-contract verifier. The protected detector uses only standard library/psutil in its own process; recovery actuators use the separate frozen native installation. New checks include named-pipe prompt delivery, bounded provider output, exact lease release, terminal poison pills, physical RED/phase order, combined100-line Git diffs and literal patch application, knowledge FTS5/corpus integrity, crash metadata, and process trends. The authoritative seven-stage planning transitions and MethodMatrix source are absent; production coding requests are durably held without runnable coding stages until that specification blocker is resolved and implemented. Do not fabricate stage labels or remove the hold. The checked-in knowledge corpus captures the four original specifications exactly. Windows/live provider acceptance and sustained performance are still external requirements; record failed timing measurements instead of converting them to passes. Use the native performance harness only on an actual provisioned Windows host; short observations cannot certify48hours, and USER/GDI counts do not prove desktop-heap use. Fresh Pipeline4.2.6/Supervisor4.2.6 installations preserve credentials, task identities and persistent job state; migrate both supervisor and component-recovery ledgers, not just paid-model budgets.
